result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Manage GGUF models from HuggingFace Hub.

USAGE:
    dotllm model [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    dotllm model search llama --limit 5
    dotllm model pull TheBloke/Llama-2-7B-GGUF --file llama-2-7b.Q4_K_M.gguf
    dotllm model info TheBloke/Llama-2-7B-GGUF
    dotllm model delete Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-GGUF
    dotllm model add C:\models\my-finetune.gguf --name my-finetune

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    search <query>               Search HuggingFace for GGUF models             
    pull <repo-id>               Download a GGUF model from HuggingFace         
    list                         List locally downloaded models                 
    info <repo-id>               Show details for a HuggingFace model repository
    delete <model>               Delete a locally downloaded model, or a model  
                                 profile                                        
    add <source>                 Add a local .gguf file (linked, not copied) or 
                                 download one from a URL                        
    create <name>                Create a named model profile: a base model plus
                                 system prompt, sampling defaults, device and   
                                 keep-alive                                     
    import-ollama                Import models from an existing ollama          
                                 installation as profiles (blobs are used in    
                                 place, nothing is copied)                      
    show <model>                 Show a profile's settings and where its model  
                                 resolves                                       
    cp <source> <destination>    Copy a profile, or alias a model under a new   
                                 profile name

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Run greedy text generation on a GGUF model.

USAGE:
    dotllm run <model> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    dotllm run QuantFactory/SmolLM-135M-GGUF --prompt The capital of France is 
--max-tokens 64

ARGUMENTS:
    <model>    Path to a GGUF file or HuggingFace repo ID (e.g.,                
               QuantFactory/SmolLM-135M-GGUF)                                   

OPTIONS:
                                  DEFAULT                                       
    -h, --help                               Prints help information            
    -v, --version                            Prints version information         
    -p, --prompt                             Input prompt for generation.       
                                             Required unless --prompt-file is   
                                             given                              
        --prompt-file                        Read the prompt from a file instead
                                             of --prompt. A single trailing     
                                             newline is stripped. Mutually      
                                             exclusive with --prompt            
    -n, --max-tokens              128        Maximum number of tokens to        
                                             generate                           
    -t, --temp                    0          Sampling temperature. 0 = greedy   
                                             (default)                          
        --top-k                   0          Top-K sampling. 0 = disabled       
        --top-p                   1          Top-P (nucleus) sampling threshold 
        --min-p                   0          Min-P sampling threshold. 0 =      
                                             disabled                           
        --repeat-penalty          1          Repetition penalty factor. 1.0 =   
                                             disabled                           
        --repeat-last-n           0    
[truncated]

    dotllm bench <model> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    dotllm bench QuantFactory/SmolLM-135M-GGUF --device cpu -p 512 -n 128 -r 5

ARGUMENTS:
    <model>    Path to a GGUF file or HuggingFace repo ID (e.g.,                
               QuantFactory/SmolLM-135M-GGUF)                                   

OPTIONS:
                            DEFAULT                                             
    -h, --help                         Prints help information                  
    -v, --version                      Prints version information               
    -d, --device            cpu        Compute device: 'cpu' (default),         
                                       'vulkan', 'cuda' / 'cuda:1' ('gpu' is an 
                                       alias for cuda)                          
    -p, --prompt-tokens     512        Synthetic prompt length in tokens (tiled 
                                       from the seed prompt)                    
    -n, --gen-tokens        128        Greedy decode steps to time per          
                                       repetition

        --depth             0          Extra synthetic context tokens fed       
                                       (untimed) after prefill, before the timed
                                       decode. Decode runs at context depth p + 
                                       depth                                    
        --seed-prompt                  Seed text tiled to synthesize the prompt

                                       files exist (e.g., Q4_K_M, Q8_0)

DESCRIPTION:
Compute perplexity over a text corpus.

USAGE:
    dotllm perplexity <model> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    dotllm perplexity QuantFactory/SmolLM-135M-GGUF --corpus wiki.test.raw 
--context 512 --stride 256

ARGUMENTS:
    <model>    Path to a GGUF file or HuggingFace repo ID (e.g.,                
               QuantFactory/SmolLM-135M-GGUF)                                   

OPTIONS:
                                    DEFAULT                                     
    -h, --help                                        Prints help information   
    -v, --version                                     Prints version information
    -f, --corpus                                      Path to a UTF-8 text      
                                                      corpus (e.g.              
                                                      wiki.test.raw)            
        --normalize-line-endings                      Collapse CRLF to LF while 
                                                      reading --corpus, as MSVC 
                                                      text mode does. OFF by    
                                                      default. Use ONLY when the
                                                      reference figure came from
                                                      a Windows llama.cpp build 
                                                      reading the same CRLF     
                                                      file; llama.cpp on Linux  
                                                      keeps the CRs, so         
                                                      normalizing there creates 
                                                      a mismatch. Preferred fix 
                                                      is an LF corpus (see      
                                                      docs/PERPLEXITY.md, issue 
                                                      #506)                     
    -c, --context

DESCRIPTION:
Unload a model (or all) from a running server (needs --allow-model-admin).

USAGE:
    dotllm stop [model] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    dotllm stop --all

ARGUMENTS:
    [model]    Model to unload (as shown by 'dotllm ps'). Omit with --all to    
               unload everything                                                

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information                                    
    -v, --version    Prints version information                                 
        --url        Server base URL (default: $DOTLLM_URL or                   
                     http://localhost:8080)                                     
        --all        Unload every resident model                                
        --server     Stop the whole server process gracefully (POST             
                     /v1/admin/shutdown)

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Launch API server with built-in web chat UI.

USAGE:
    dotllm serve [model] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    dotllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B-GGUF --port 8080

ARGUMENTS:
    [model]    Path to a GGUF file or HuggingFace repo ID. Omit to start without
               a model (load from UI)                                           

OPTIONS:
                                    DEFAULT                                     
    -h, --help                                   Prints help information        
    -v, --version                                Prints version information     
    -p, --port                      8080         Port to listen on              
        --host                      localhost    Host address to bind to        
    -d, --device                    auto         Compute device: 'auto'         
                                                 (default: CUDA if the model    
                                                 fits, else Vulkan, else CPU - a
                                                 failed GPU load falls back),   
                                                 'cpu', 'gpu', 'gpu:0', 'gpu:1' 
                                                 (CUDA), or 'vulkan'            
        --gpu-layers                             Number of transformer layers to
                                                 offload to GPU                 
        --threads                   0            Number of CPU threads for      
                                                 inference. 0 = auto            
        --decode-threads            0            Number of threads for decode. 0
                                                 = auto                         
    -q, --quant                                  Quantization filter when       
                                                 multiple GGUF files exist      
                                                 (e.g., Q4_K_M, Q8_0)           
        --cache-type-k              f32          KV-cache key quantization: f32 
 
[truncated]
